title: Centi-Beetles
hook: Player-safe note: Giant centi-beetles chew root and loam into low tunnels, making the ground sound busy even when nobody is walking.

blocks.label: Observed Form
blocks.body: Give one concrete visual, one sound or texture, and one sign of who has used or neglected it.

blocks.label: Behavior
blocks.body: Giant centi-beetles chew root and loam into low tunnels, making the ground sound busy even when nobody is walking.; show instinct first through distance, posture, scent, and how the creature protects what is close to it.

blocks.label: Warning Signs
blocks.body: Being surrounded, misread as a monster, or driven toward Root's Hollow, Underroot, Underroot Tunnels by noise and haste.

affordances: Give it distance before deciding it is hostile.
Read posture, tracks, and what it is protecting.
